info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Business Contribution Analysis API
info.description: The Business Contribution Analysis API provides tools for organizations to evaluate and understand the contributions of various aspects of their operations. Through this API, users can submit analysis requests and obtain detailed insights about business performance metrics. This functionality is vital for decision-makers, analysts, and financial planners aiming to optimize resource allocation and enhance profitability. The API streamlines the analysis process, enabling efficient assessment and reporting on business contributions in a variety of sectors.

post.description: This endpoint allows users to create a new contribution analysis for the business, enabling better understanding and tracking of contributions across various parameters.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to initiate a contribution analysis within the business analysis framework. It requires specific input parameters structured in a JSON format to efficiently process the analysis request.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning the analysis result.
